title: Russia kills 17 in ballistic missile attacks around Kyiv
english: A recent overnight assault by Russia involving ballistic missiles and drones has resulted in at least 17 deaths in and around the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv. While Ukrainian officials report that the strikes caused significant damage to civilian facilities, Moscow claims their military actions were directed specifically at defense targets. This deadly attack marks a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict between the two nations.
amharic: ሩሲያ በኪየቭ እና በአካባቢዋ ባደረሰችው የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል እና የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 17 ሰዎች መሞታቸው ተዘግቧል። የዩክሬን ባለሥልጣናት ጥቃቱ የሲቪል መሰረተ ልማቶችን ኢላማ ያደረገ መሆኑን ሲገልጹ፣ ሞስኮ በበኩሏ ወታደራዊ ቦታዎችን ማጥቃቷን ትናገራለች። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው ጦርነት ከፍተኛ መባባሱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Rusiyan magaalaa Kiyivii fi naannawa ishee irratti haleellaa kombii fi miisayilii baaliistikii taasisteen namoonni 17 ol ajjeefamaniiru. Mootummaan Yukreen haleellaan kun bu'uuraalee misoomaa sivilii irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu ibsuun, gama biraatiin immoo Moskon haleellaa kana bakkeewwan waraanaa irratti qofa gaggeessine jechuun falmati. Haleellaan kun waldhabiinsa biyyoota lamaanii gidduutti jiru gara sadarkaa hamaatti dabarsuun isaa ibsameera.

title: Pope Leo XIV to visit Peru, Argentina and Uruguay in November
english: Pope Leo XIV is scheduled to visit Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru this November, marking his first papal trip to Latin America. This visit is highly significant as it includes a return to Peru, where the Pope previously served as a missionary and bishop for many years. Additionally, the trip will be the first papal visit to Argentina and Uruguay in nearly four decades.

oromo: Paappaan Leo 14ffaan ji'a Sadaasaa keessa biyyoota Urugway, Arjantiinaa fi Peeruu daawwachuuf karoorfateera. Daawwachi kun taayitaa paappaummaa erga fudhatanii booda gara Laatin Ameerikaatti kan godhan imala jalqabaati. Keessattuu, waggoota dheeraaf misiyoonaarii fi phaaphaasii ta'anii tajaajilaa turan biyya Peeruu deebi'anii daawwachuun isaanii addatti kan barbaachisuudha; akkasumas kun waggoota 40 keessatti biyyoota Arjantiinaa fi Urugwayitti imala paappaasii jalqabaa ta'a.

title: Puerto Rican cities hit with water rationing measures during record drought
english: Puerto Rico has initiated rotating water rationing for over 180,000 residents in San Juan and surrounding areas due to a record-breaking, severe drought. Governor Jenniffer Gonzalez noted that the measures are necessary as extreme dry weather and heat are expected to continue through September. Many citizens are struggling with these new restrictions, noting that their communities have already faced inconsistent water supplies for months.

oromo: Puerto Rico keessatti gogiinsi cimaan uumamee waan jiruuf, magaalaa San Juan fi naannoowwan ishee keessatti jiraattonni 180,000 ol ta'an bishaan hiruun itti fayyadamuuf dirqamaniiru. Mootummaan akka ibsetetti, roobni dhabamuu fi ho’i cimaan hanga baatii Fulbaanaatti itti fufu waan maluuf, murteen kun fudhatameera. Jiraattonni hedduun haala kanaan dura bishaan dhabuun isaan mudachaa ture yaadachaa, murteen kun jireenya isaanii irratti rakkoo dabalataa uumuu isaa ibsachaa jiru.

title: Arab officials call for action over Jerusalem tensions
english: Foreign ministers from various Arab and Muslim-majority nations recently convened in Amman to discuss rising instability in Jerusalem and the occupied Palestinian territories. The participating officials urged the global community to take urgent steps to stop Israeli actions in the region. They also emphasized the necessity of ensuring the safety and protection of sacred religious sites.
amharic: የተለያዩ የአረብ እና ሙስሊም አገራት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በኢየሩሳሌም እና በተያዙት የፍልስጤም ግዛቶች እየተባባሰ የመጣውን አለመረጋጋት ለመወያየት በአማን ተሰብስበዋል። የተሳታፊዎቹ ሀገራት ዲፕሎማቶች ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ በእስራኤል በኩል የሚፈጸሙ ጥሰቶችን ለማስቆም አስቸኳይ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ቅዱስ የሃይማኖት ስፍራዎችን የመጠበቅ እና የደህንነታቸውን የማረጋገጥ አስፈላጊነት ላይ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa biyyoota Arabaa fi biyyoota muslima hedduu ta'an irraa walitti dhufan, rakkoo Yerusaalemii fi naannawaa Palasxinaa keessatti uumame irratti mari'achuuf magaalaa Ammanitti walga'ii gaggeessaniiru. Qondaalonni kunneen gochoota Israa'el naannichatti raawwattu dhaabsisuuf hawaasni addunyaa tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa akka fudhatu gaafataniiru. Akkasumas, bakkeewwan amantii qulqulluu ta'an eeggumsa argachuu akka qaban hubachiisaniiru.

title: Top Arab, Muslim diplomats launch plan to protect Jerusalem religious sites
english: Foreign ministers from various Arab and Muslim nations have formed a new collaborative committee to monitor and publicize Israeli actions affecting religious sites in East Jerusalem. They aim to use a dedicated media platform to highlight concerns about the status of holy places, such as the Al-Aqsa Mosque, to the international community. The group warns that these ongoing policies threaten regional stability and violate the historical identity of the city.
amharic: የተለያዩ የአረብ እና የእስልምና ሀገራት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም በሚገኙ ሃይማኖታዊ ስፍራዎች ላይ እስራኤል የምትወስዳቸውን እርምጃዎች ለመከታተልና ለዓለም ለማጋለጥ የሚያስችል የጋራ ኮሚቴ አቋቁመዋል። ቡድኑ የአል-አቅሳ መስጊድን ጨምሮ የቅዱስ ስፍራዎችን ሁኔታ ለዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ለማሳወቅ ልዩ የሚዲያ መድረክ እንደሚጠቀም አስታውቋል። እነዚህ እየተካሄዱ ያሉ ድርጊቶች የክልሉን ሰላም አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥሉና የከተማዋን ታሪካዊ ማንነት እንደሚሸረሽሩም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa biyyoota Arabaa fi Muslimaa garaa garaa, tarkaanfii Israa'el iddoowwan amantii magaalaa Yerusaalem keessatti fudhattu hordofuu fi addunyaatti ibsuuf garee waliinii tokko hundeessaniiru. Gareen kun, masjiida Al-Aqsaa dabalatee iddoowwan qulqulluu irratti miidhaa gahaa jiru hunda miidiyaalee addunyaatti beeksisuuf karoorfateera. Tarkaanfiin Israa'el kun nagaa naannichaa kan booressuu fi eenyummaa seenaa magaalaashee kan jijjiiru ta'uu isaatiin hubachiisaniiru.

title: Rubio, Miliband discuss Europe taking greater role in its own security
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband in Washington to discuss the need for European nations to increase their responsibility for regional security. This meeting follows Miliband's recent appointment by Prime Minister Andy Burnham. Despite the focus on security cooperation, the White House has expressed apprehension regarding Miliband's previous environmental policy decisions.
amharic: የአሜሪካው የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ከእንግሊዝ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ኤድ ሚሊባንድ ጋር በዋሽንግተን ተገናኝተው በአውሮፓ የደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ ተወያይተዋል። ውይይቱ በአውሮፓ አገራት የራሳቸውን ደህንነት የመጠበቅ ኃላፊነት እንዲጨምሩ የሚያሳስብ ነው። ሆኖም፣ የዋይት ሃውስ በኤድ ሚሊባንድ የቀድሞ የአየር ንብረት ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ያለውን ስጋት ገልጿል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Amerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo fi Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa UK Eed Miilibaandi Waashingitanitti wal arguun, biyyoonni Awurooppaa nageenya naannawa isaanii eeggachuu irratti qooda guddaa akka qabaatan mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun muudama Miilibaandi kan haaraa booda kan ta'e yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin garuu, Waayit Haawusiin siyaasa inni kanaan dura dhimma naannoo irratti hordofaa ture ilaalchisee yaaddoo qabaachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Eight Palestinians injured in large-scale Israeli raid of Jerusalem refugee camp
english: Israeli forces conducted a major military operation in the Qalandiya refugee camp and Kafr Aqab, resulting in eight injuries among Palestinians. During the raid, the military imposed strict movement restrictions, detained several individuals, and targeted journalists reporting on the event. The operation also involved placing snipers in residential areas and disrupting local religious services.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በቃላንድያ የስደተኞች ካምፕ እና በካፍር አቃብ ከተማ ባደረገው ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ስምንት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። በዘመቻው ወቅት ጦሩ ጥብቅ የሰዓታት እላፊ በመጣል፣ በርካታ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሎ፣ እንዲሁም ክንውኑን በመዘገብ ላይ የነበሩ ጋዜጠኞችን አሳድዷል። በተጨማሪም ወታደሮቹ በየቤቱ ጣሪያ ላይ ተኳሾችን በማስቀመጥ እና የሃይማኖታዊ ስነ-ስርዓቶችን በማስተጓጎል አካባቢውን ሙሉ በሙሉ ተቆጣጥረውት ነበር።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el buufata baqattootaa Qalandiyaa fi magaalaa Kafr Aqaab keessatti duula waraanaa bal'aa gaggeessaniin Palastinaa saddeet irra miidhaan ga'eera. Duula kanaan, waraanni ajaja mana keessatti qabamuu labsuun namoota hedduu hidheera, akkasumas gabaastota ta'ichi gabaasaa turan irratti tarkaanfiin fudhatameera. Duulichi halkan keessa warreen rasaasaa dhukaasan gamoo irratti ramaduu fi sagantaalee amantii gufachiisuu dabalata.

title: Netanyahu says Trump is a ‘great friend’ but Israel will do ‘whatever it takes’ for security
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated that his country will prioritize its national security above all else, regardless of any international agreements. While acknowledging Donald Trump as a strong ally, he emphasized that Israel’s survival is non-negotiable. This declaration follows Israel's ongoing military actions in southern Lebanon despite efforts by the U.S. to broker a withdrawal deal.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የሀገራቸው ደህንነት ከማንኛውም ዓለም አቀፍ ስምምነት በላይ ቅድሚያ እንደሚሰጠው አስታውቀዋል። ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ለእስራኤል ትልቅ ወዳጅ መሆናቸውን የገለጹት ኔታንያሁ፣ የእስራኤል ህልውና ድርድር የማይደረግበት ጉዳይ መሆኑን አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው አሜሪካ በሊባኖስ በኩል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ለማድረግ እየሞከረች ባለችበት ወቅት፣ እስራኤል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ወታደራዊ ጥቃቷን የቀጠለችበት ጊዜ ላይ ነው።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Neetaanyaahuu, mootummaan isaa nageenya biyyasaatiif jecha, walii galtee idil-addunyaa kamiyyuu osoo hin eegatin tarkaanfii barbaachisu fudhachuu akka itti fufu ibsaniiru. Donald Tiraamp hiriyyaa cimaa ta'uu isaanii kan dubbatan ta'us, jiraachuu fi nageenyi Israa'el dhimma marii irra hin oollee dha jedhaniiru. Ibsi kun kan ba'e, yeroo Ameerikaan walii galtee nagaa Libaanoos keessatti uumuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtutti, Israa'el kibba Libaanoos keessatti haleellaa waraanaa itti fuftee jirtutti.

title: UK maritime authority reports ‘loud explosion’ near ship southeast of Yemeni coast
english: British maritime officials have reported a powerful blast occurring near a ship located southeast of the Yemeni port of Aden. Despite the incident, authorities confirmed that the crew members are unharmed and the vessel has sustained no environmental damage. An official investigation and warning have been issued regarding the safety of the area.
amharic: የብሪታንያ የባህር ላይ ንግድ ኦፕሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ከየመን አደን ወደብ በስተደቡብ ምስራቅ በኩል በአንድ መርከብ አቅራቢያ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ እንደተከሰተ አስታውቀዋል። በዚህ አደጋ የመርከቧ ሰራተኞች ምንም ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰባቸውና በአካባቢውም የአካባቢ ብክለት አለመፈጠሩን አረጋግጠዋል። ስለ ሁኔታው አስፈላጊው ማስጠንቀቂያ የተላለፈ ሲሆን ተጨማሪ ክትትል እየተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa daldala galaanaa biyya Ingiliz, markabii gara kibba-baha buufata markabaa Aden kan Yemenitti dhihoo jirtu biratti dhuka'iinsa guddaan tokko akka mudate gabaasaniiru. Balaa kanaan, hojjettoonni markabittii hundi miidhaa tokko malee nagaan akka jiranifi naannichattis balaan naannoo irra gahe akka hin jirre ibsameera. Taateen kun hordofamaa jiraachuun beekameera.

title: Exclusive: Cambridge University backtracks on divesting from arms companies
english: The University of Cambridge has reversed its decision to completely divest from companies involved in arms manufacturing. Instead, the institution will now implement a monitoring system to track and limit its financial exposure to conventional weapons producers. This policy shift follows recent pressure and protests from students advocating for the university to cut ties with the defense industry.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ከጦር መሳሪያ አምራች ኩባንያዎች ጋር ያለውን የገንዘብ ግንኙነት ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማቋረጥ የነበረውን ውሳኔ ቀይሯል። በምትኩ፣ ተቋሙ በጦር መሳሪያ አምራቾች ላይ ያለውን የኢንቨስትመንት ድርሻ የሚከታተል እና የሚገድብ አዲስ ሥርዓት ዘርግቷል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው ዩኒቨርሲቲው ከጦር መሳሪያ ኢንዱስትሪዎች ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት እንዲያቋርጥ በተማሪዎች ከቀረበው ተደጋጋሚ ተጽዕኖ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Yuunivarsiitiin Kaambirij warshaalee meeshaa waraanaa oomishan irraa qabeenya isaa guututti baasuuf murteeffatee ture akka waaqatti deebisee jira. Kanaa mannaa, dhaabbatichi amma qabeenya isaa warshaalee meeshaa waraanaa irratti bobbaase to'achuufi daangessuuf sirna haaraa diriirse jira. Murteen kun kan dhufeyis barattoonni dhaabbatichi warshaalee meeshaa waraanaa wajjin walitti dhufeenya akka qabaatu hin barbaanne jechuun dhiibbaa taasisaa turan booda dha.

title: Left-wing political outsider wins Democratic Senate primary in Michigan
english: Abdul El-Sayed, a progressive newcomer and former public health official, has secured the Democratic nomination for the US Senate in Michigan by defeating moderate incumbent Haley Stevens. His platform focuses on universal healthcare and major changes to immigration and foreign policy. El-Sayed will now compete against Republican Mike Rogers in the upcoming November midterm elections.
amharic: አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ የተባሉ የግራ ዘመም ፖለቲካዊ አመለካከት ያላቸው አዲስ ሰው፣ በሚቺጋን ግዛት በተካሄደው የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ የምርጫ ውድድር አሸንፈዋል። የቀድሞው የህዝብ ጤና ባለስልጣን የሆኑት ኤል-ሰይድ፣ በመካከለኛ አቋም የሚታወቁትን ሄሊ ስቲቨንስን በመርታት ለእጩነት በቅተዋል። አሸናፊው እጩ በሚቀጥለው ህዳር በሚካሄደው የሀገር አቀፍ ምርጫ ከሪፐብሊካኑ ማይክ ሮጀርስ ጋር ይፎካከራሉ።
oromo: Abduul El-Sayed kan jedhaman fi siyaasa gara bitaa kan deggeran namni haaraan kun, filannoo duraa kan paartii Dimookiraatawaa kan miichiigan keessatti gaggeeffame injifataniiru. Ogeessi fayyaa hawaasaa duraanii kun, namoota giddu-galeessa ta'an kan Haley Stevens jedhaman mo'achuun muudama paartichaa argataniiru. Injifataan kunis filannoo biyyoolessa kan ji'a Sadaasaa dhufu keessa namicha Paartii Ripaabilikaanii kan ta'an Mike Rogers wajjin kan dorgoman ta'a.

title: What can scientists learn from a stray SpaceX rocket hitting the Moon?
english: A discarded SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket stage recently crashed into the Moon near the Einstein crater at high speed. While the impact was difficult to observe due to lighting conditions, scientists view this accidental collision as a valuable research opportunity. By studying the resulting crater, planetary geologists hope to gain new insights that will benefit future space missions.
amharic: የስፔስ ኤክስ (SpaceX) ፋልኮን 9 ሮኬት ክፍል በቅርቡ በጨረቃ ላይ በሚገኘው የአይንስታይን ጉድጓድ አቅራቢያ በከፍተኛ ፍጥነት ተጋጭቷል። ይህ አደጋ በጨረቃ ገጽ ላይ የፈጠረውን ጉድጓድ ማጥናት ለሳይንቲስቶች አዲስ እና ጠቃሚ መረጃዎችን ለማግኘት ዕድል ሰጥቷቸዋል። ተመራማሪዎች ከዚህ ግጭት የሚገኘውን መረጃ ለወደፊት የጠፈር ጉዞዎች ስኬት እንደሚጠቀሙበት ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Kutaan rokkeetii SpaceX Falcon 9 ta'e tokko dhiheenya kana saffisa olaanaadhaan gara ji'aatti bu'ee 'Einstein crater' jedhamu biratti qaxxaamura uumera. Taphni kun erga uumamee booda, saayintistoonni iddoo sanatti uumamee qorachuun odeeffannoo gara fuulduraatti ergawwan hawaa fayyadan argachuuf carraa guddaa akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Qorattoonni rokkeetiin sun ji'a irratti midhaa geessise irraa hubannoo haaraa akka argatan abdachiisaniiru.

title: UN rights chief alarmed by rise in Iran executions since March
english: The UN human rights chief has expressed deep concern over the sharp increase in executions in Iran since March, noting that the death penalty is being used to silence political opposition. Since late March, at least 56 individuals have been executed, with many others facing similar threats or suffering from unfair trial processes. Volker Türk has called on the Iranian government to stop these executions, highlighting that many of these cases involve forced confessions obtained through torture.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብት ኮሚሽነር ከማርች ወር ወዲህ በኢራን እየጨመረ የመጣውን የሞት ቅጣት አፈጻጸም በጥብቅ አውግዘዋል። ኮሚሽነሩ መንግስት ይህንን እርምጃ ተቃውሞዎችን ለማፈን እና ህዝብን ለማስፈራራት እየተጠቀመበት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። እስካሁን ቢያንስ 56 ሰዎች የተገደሉ ሲሆን፣ ብዙዎች ደግሞ በጭካኔ በተሞላበት ምርመራ እና ፍትሃዊ ባልሆነ የፍርድ ሂደት ተመሳሳይ እጣ ፈንታ እንደሚጠብቃቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Hogganaan mirga namoomaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akkaataa Iran keessatti baay'inni ajjeechaa adabbii du'aa itti dabalaa jiruuf yaaddoo guddaa qaban ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Iran tarkaanfii kana mormitoota cal'isiisuufi uummata sodaachisuuf akka itti fayyadamaa jiru himameera. Jijjiirama ji'a Bitootessaa asitti namoota 56 ol ta'an kan ajjeefaman yoo ta'u, namoonni biroon hedduunis mirgaa fi qulqullina dhaddacha malee ajjeefamuuf balaa keessa jiru.

title: War on Iran: US-Iran deal edges closer
english: United States officials have indicated that a potential agreement with Iran could be finalized within the next two days. The primary focus of the deal is to secure the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. This arrangement is viewed as a preliminary step that may lead to more comprehensive diplomatic discussions between the two nations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ከአሜሪካ እና ከኢራን መካከል የሚደረግ ስምምነት በሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ ሊፈረም ይችላል። ስምምነቱ በዋናነት የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን እንደገና መክፈት ላይ ያተኩራል። ይህ ድርድር በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ለሚኖሩ ሰፊ የዲፕሎማሲ ንግግሮች እንደ መጀመሪያ እርምጃ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Ameerikaa akka ibsanitti, walii galteen Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti godhamu guyyoota lama keessatti mallatteeffamuu danda'a. Walii galteen kun kan xiyyeeffatu cufaa galaana Hormuz banuu irratti dha. Kuniis walii galtee kan duraa ta'ee, gara fuulduraatti marii dhimma biyyoota lamaanii irratti bal'inaan taasifamuuf karra banuu danda'a.

title: Germany investigates explosive device attached to drone at Leipzig airport
english: German authorities are investigating an incident at Leipzig/Halle Airport after a drone carrying an unidentified explosive device was discovered near a runway. Police successfully removed the device's detonator, and officials have confirmed there is no ongoing threat to the public. Investigators are also looking into a separate incident where a freight plane sustained minor damage after striking an unidentified object, though they have not yet linked the two events.
amharic: የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት በሊፕዚግ/ሃሌ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ አቅራቢያ ፈንጂ የተገጠመለት ድሮን በመገኘቱ ምርመራ ጀምረዋል። ፖሊስ የፈንጂውን ማቀጣጠያ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ማስወገዱን እና ለህዝብ ደህንነት ስጋት እንደሌለ አረጋግጠዋል። ባለስልጣናት አንድ የጭነት አውሮፕላን ያልታወቀ ነገር በመግጠሙ ጉዳት የደረሰበትን ሌላ ክስተት እየመረመሩ ቢሆንም ሁለቱን ክስተቶች እስካሁን አላገናኙዋቸውም።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Jarman dirree xiyyaaraa Leepzig/Haallee keessatti xiyyaara xiqoo (droonii) meeshaa waraanaa baachaa ture erga argamee booda qorannoo eegalaniiru. Poolisiin meeshaa sanatti kan hidhamee ture qabsiiftuu isaa erga hiikee booda, ummataaf balaan akka hin jirre mirkaneesseera. Kana malees, xiyyaara fe'umsaa tokkorra miidhaan xiqqoon ga'uu isaa hordofee qorannoon gaggeeffamaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti gochoota lameen kan walqabsiise ragaan hin jiru.

title: Demolition complicates the search for bodies after Venezuela’s earthquakes
english: Following twin earthquakes in Venezuela, authorities have begun demolishing unstable buildings to clear debris. This process has sparked controversy as families, like those of Glenda Viloria, are still searching for the bodies of missing loved ones buried under the rubble. The removal of these structures is making the recovery effort significantly more difficult and emotionally painful for survivors.
amharic: በቬንዙዌላ በተከሰተው መንታ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ምክንያት ባለስልጣናት ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ ያልሆኑ ህንጻዎችን ማፍረስ ጀምረዋል። ይሁን እንጂ በፍርስራሽ ስር የጠፉባቸውን ቤተሰቦች እየፈለጉ ባሉ ሰዎች ዘንድ ይህ ውሳኔ ከፍተኛ ቅሬታን ፈጥሯል። ህንጻዎቹ መፍረሳቸው የሟቾችን አስክሬን የመፈለግ ስራውን ይበልጥ አዳጋችና ለተጎጂዎችም ስሜታዊ ጫናው የከፋ እንዲሆን አድርጎታል።
oromo: Sodaa sochiin lafaa (earthquake) namoota hedduu ajjeese booda, mootummaan Venezuela ijaarsaaleen diigamanii turan akka manca'an gochuutti jira. Haa ta'u malee, tarkaanfiin kun maatiiwwan fira isaanii dhabanii fi reeffa isaanii barbaadaa jiraniif mufannaa guddaa uumeera. Ijaarsaalee kana diiguun tattaaffii reeffa barbaaduu san caalaatti rakkisaa fi miira namoota midhamanii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa akka geessisu taasiseera.

title: Gaza father opens play center to restore childhood amid Israeli attacks
english: A Palestinian father in Gaza has established an indoor play area to provide children with a sense of normalcy despite ongoing conflict. The facility offers a safe space for kids to play amidst the daily dangers of the war. Families facing financial hardship are welcome to use the center at no cost.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚኖር አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ አባት በጦርነት ውስጥ የሚገኙ ህጻናት መደበኛ የልጅነት ህይወትን እንዲለማመዱ ለማድረግ የመጫወቻ ማዕከል ከፍቷል። ይህ ማዕከል ህጻናት ከዕለት ተዕለት የጦርነት ስጋት ውጭ በደህና እንዲጫወቱ የሚያስችል ቦታ ይፈጥራል። ችግረኛ ቤተሰቦችም ያለምንም ክፍያ ልጆቻቸውን እንዲያስገቡ ተፈቅዶላቸዋል።
oromo: Abbaan tokko Gaza keessatti argamu, ijoolleen waraana keessa jiran gammadanii akka taphatanfi tasgabbii akka argatanif iddoo tapha keessaa baneera. Iddoon kun ijoolleen miidhaa waraana guyyaa guyyaan isaan mudatu irraa bilisa ta'anii akka taphatan gargaara. Maatii harka qalleeyyii ta'aniifis tajaajilli kun kaffaltii tokko malee kennamaa jira.

title: Boxer Chapman recovering after emergency surgery for brain bleed
english: British boxer Raven Chapman is recovering after undergoing emergency brain surgery following a collapse during a training session in Denmark on July 24. Doctors treated her for brain bleeding and swelling, placing her in a medically induced coma before successfully stabilizing her condition. She is now awake and receiving further care while arrangements are being made to bring her back to the UK for long-term rehabilitation.
amharic: የብሪታኒያዋ ቦክሰኛ ሬቨን ቻፕማን በዴንማርክ ልምምድ ላይ እያለች በድንገት በመውደቋ በአስቸኳይ የአንጎል ቀዶ ጥገና ተደርጎላት ማገገም ጀምራለች። ሀኪሞች የአንጎል ደም መፍሰስ እና እብጠት እንዳለባት ደርሰውበት የቀዶ ጥገና ህክምና ካደረጉላት በኋላ በኮማ ውስጥ እንዲትቆይ ተደርጎ ነበር። በአሁኑ ጊዜ ከህክምናው በማገገም ላይ የምትገኝ ሲሆን፣ ለቀጣይ የረጅም ጊዜ ህክምና ወደ እንግሊዝ ለመመለስ ዝግጅት እየተደረገላት ነው።
oromo: Boqsarriin biyya Ingiliz Raven Chapman jedhamtu, ji'a darbe qophii leenjii irratti yeroo kufuun ishee erga mudatee booda, marsaa xannacha mataa irraa garaa baqaqsanii wal'aanamuun ishee beekameera. Doktooronni dhiiga mataa keessatti dhangala'eefi dhiitaa jiru to'achuuf ariitiidhaan ishee wal'aananiiru. Yeroo ammaa haalli fayyaa ishee fooyya'aa kan jiru yoo ta'u, erga isheen fayyitee booda gara biyya ishee deebitee akka wal'aansa itti fufuuf qophiin taasifamaa jira.

title: Iran, Oman agree on Hormuz route coordinates
english: Iran and Oman have reached a mutual agreement regarding the specific geographic coordinates for maritime travel through the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian officials are currently preparing a formal joint declaration but have expressed concern about potential interference from outside nations. The government also noted that while this deal is a step forward, it does not independently ensure complete security for the crucial shipping lane.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር የሚያልፍ የመርከብ መስመር መጋጠሚያዎች ላይ ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል። የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር እንዳስታወቀው፣ ሁለቱ ሀገራት መግለጫ ለማውጣት እየተዘጋጁ ቢሆንም የውጭ ጣልቃገብነት ስጋት እንዳላቸው ገልጸዋል። ስምምነቱ ትልቅ እርምጃ ቢሆንም የባህር መንገዱን ደህንነት ሙሉ በሙሉ እንደማያረጋግጥም ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Iiraan fi Oomaan daandii markaboonni Itti fayyadaman kan galaana Hormuz irratti waliigaltee irra ga'aniiru. Mootummaan Iiraan akka ibsetti, waliigaltee kana ifa gochuuf qophiirra jiraatanis, qaamonni alaa dhiibbaa uumuu danda'u jedhanii yaadu. Waliigalteen kun tarkaanfii gaarii ta'us, nageenya daandii galaana kanaa guutumaan guututti mirkaneessuuf gahaa akka hin taane ibsameera.

title: Exclusive: Cambridge University backtracks on divesting from arms companies
english: The University of Cambridge has reversed its previous commitment to divest from arms companies. Although the university initially established a strict policy to monitor and reduce investments in weapons manufacturers, it has now quietly replaced this with a plan that no longer requires actual divestment. Student activists have expressed frustration, stating that this shift in policy is a betrayal of the university's earlier promises regarding their financial ties to the arms industry.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ከጦር መሳሪያ አምራች ኩባንያዎች ጋር ያለውን የኢንቨስትመንት ግንኙነት ለማቋረጥ የገባውን ቃል ወደኋላ ብሎታል። ዩኒቨርሲቲው ቀደም ሲል የጦር መሳሪያ ኩባንያዎችን ኢንቨስትመንት ለመከታተል እና ለመቀነስ ጥብቅ እቅድ አውጥቶ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ አሁን ግን ይህንን እቅድ በተግባር ኢንቨስትመንትን የማያቋርጥ አዲስ አማራጭ በድብቅ ተክቶታል። የተማሪዎች እንቅስቃሴ አስተባባሪዎች ዩኒቨርሲቲው ከዚህ ቀደም የገባውን ቃል በመጣሱ ከፍተኛ ቅሬታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Yuunivarsiitiin Kaambiriij, dhaabbilee meeshaalee waraanaa oomishan irratti invastimentii gochuu dhaabuuf kanaan dura waadaa galtee turte duubatti deebiteetti. Yuunivarsiitiin kun jalqaba irratti invastimentiiwwan meeshaalee waraanaa hordofuu fi hir'isuuf karoorfatee turee kan ture ta'us, amma garuu sagantaa kana invastimentii dhaabuu hin dirqisiifne biraatiin bakka buusuun isaa ifa ta'eera. Barattoonni falmitoonni, tarkaanfiin kun waadaa yuunivarsiitiin kanaan dura galtee ture kan cabsaniifi dhugaa jiru kan dhoksan ta'uu ibsuun mormii isaanii dhageessisaniiru.

title: Afternoon update
english: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated following an Israeli drone strike in southern Lebanon and a major military operation in an East Jerusalem refugee camp, while the death toll in Gaza continues to climb. Meanwhile, the Houthis have targeted another Saudi oil tanker in the Red Sea. Additionally, Iran is nearing a potential agreement with Oman regarding control over the Strait of Hormuz, though diplomatic progress remains hindered by political tensions.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ድሮን ጥቃት እና በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም በተካሄደ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ውጥረት እየጨመረ ሲሆን በጋዛ የሟቾች ቁጥርም በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ አድጓል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በቀይ ባህር የሳውዲ ዘይት መጫኛ መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ቁጥጥር ዙሪያ ከኦማን ጋር ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ እየተቃረበች መሆኑን የገለጸች ሲሆን ሆኖም የፖለቲካ አለመግባባቶች ሂደት ላይ እንቅፋት ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gara kibba Libanoositti ergaa roketii fi doonii qilleensa irraa raawwateen du'a fi miidhaan gahuu isaa hordofee naannichatti waraanni hammaachaa jira. Gama biraatiin, Hutiin doonii boba'aa Saudii irratti Red Sea keessatti haleellaa raawwataniiru, akkasumas Gaza keessatti lakkoofsi namoota du'anii daran dabalaa jira. Kana gidduutti, Iraan galaana Hormuz to'achuu irratti biyya Omaanii waliin walii galtee irra gahuuf kan jirtu ta'us, dhiibbaan siyaasaa fi xiqqaachuun tasgabbii waliigaltee kana gufachiisaa jira.

title: Israel's army to set up polling stations in occupied Gaza, Lebanon and Syria
english: The Israeli military is preparing to set up voting stations for soldiers deployed in Gaza, Lebanon, and Syria for the upcoming general election on October 27. Military officials have created special procedures, such as using service numbers for identification, to allow combat troops to vote while stationed in these regions. While special polling is common for security forces, this specific expansion into these occupied territories is considered a rare move by the Israeli military.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በጥቅምት 27 በሚካሄደው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ በጋዛ፣ በሊባኖስ እና በሶሪያ ለሚገኙ ወታደሮች ድምፅ መስጫ ጣቢያዎችን ለማቋቋም ዝግጅት እያደረገ ነው። የጦር አዛዦች ወታደሮች በነዚህ አካባቢዎች ሆነው ድምፃቸውን እንዲሰጡ ለማስቻል እንደ ወታደራዊ መታወቂያ ቁጥር ያሉ ልዩ አሰራሮችን ዘርግተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ለጸጥታ ኃይሎች ልዩ የምርጫ ጣቢያዎች መቋቋም የተለመደ ቢሆንም፣ አሁን የተወሰደው እርምጃ በእነዚህ በተያዙ ግዛቶች ውስጥ መደረጉ በዓይነቱ ለየት ያለ ሆኗል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el filannoo biyyaalessaa Onkololeessa 27 gaggeeffamuuf, waraana Gaaza, Libaanoosii fi Sooriyaa keessatti bobba'aniif iddoo sagalee itti kennan qopheessaa jira. Ajajoonni waraanaa waraanni bakka jiranitti sagalee kennuu akka danda'aniif, koodii tajaajilaa fayyadamuun haala mijeesseera. Gargaarota nageenyaatiif iddoo filannoo addaa qopheessuun kan barame ta'us, amma garuu naannoowwan qabaman kanneen keessatti iddoo filannoo dhaabuun Israa'eliif tarkaanfii haaraa fi iddoo guddaa qabuudha.

title: Social media platform X says it is challenging block of jailed Istanbul mayor's account
english: The social media platform X is legally challenging a Turkish government order to block an account supporting the presidential candidacy of jailed Istanbul Mayor Ekrem Imamoglu. While X claims it is opposing the restriction to maintain transparency, digital rights experts remain skeptical, noting that the platform frequently complies with Turkish removal requests. Other major platforms like Meta and YouTube have also restricted content related to the mayor in accordance with local regulations.
amharic: የኤክስ (X) ማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መድረክ በቱርክ መንግስት ታስረው የሚገኙት የኢስታንቡል ከንቲባ ኤክሬም ኢማሞግሉን የፕሬዚዳንታዊ እጩነት የሚደግፍ የትዊተር ገጽ እንዲታገድ የተሰጠውን ትዕዛዝ በህጋዊ መንገድ እየተከራከረበት መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ኩባንያው ግልፅነትን ለመፍጠር በሚል እርምጃውን እየተቃወመ መሆኑን ቢገልጽም፣ የዲጂታል መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን መድረኩ ቀደም ሲልም በተደጋጋሚ የቱርክን የይዘት ማስወገጃ ጥያቄዎች ሲቀበል እንደነበረ በመጥቀስ ጥርጣሬያቸውን ገልጸዋል። እንደ ሜታ እና ዩቲዩብ ያሉ ሌሎች ዋና ዋና የመረጃ መድረኮችም የቱርክን ህግ በመከተል ከከንቲባው ጋር የተያያዙ መረጃዎችን መገደባቸው ታውቋል።
oromo: Bu'uuree miidiyaa hawaasaa X, mootummaan Turkii gufuuwwan xalayaa fi marsariitii kantiibaa Istanbul hidhamanii jiran Ekrem Imamoglu deggaran irratti kaye qeequudhaan mana murtiitti falmachaa jira. X qulqullinaa fi iftoominaaf jecha murtee kana mormaa akka jiru himus, ogeeyyiin mirga diijitaalaa garuu mootummaan Turkii yeroo baay'ee gaaffiiwwan akkasii waan fudhataniif shakkiin jira jedhu. Akkasumas, dhaabbileen akka Metaa fi Yuutuubii seera biyyattii hordofudhaan ergaawwan kantiibicha waliin walqabatanii turan daangessuun isaanii ni yaadatama.

title: Drone carrying explosives found at German airport, police say
english: German authorities are investigating a drone found near the Leipzig/Halle Airport that allegedly carried an explosive device. The discovery led to temporary flight diversions and the closure of a major runway, with officials describing the event as a severe security threat. Authorities are now looking into potential links to foreign sabotage, noting a recent increase in mysterious drone sightings over sensitive infrastructure in Germany.
amharic: የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት በሌይፕዚግ/ሃሌ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ አቅራቢያ ፈንጂ የያዘ ድሮን መገኘቱን ተከትሎ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ ክስተት የአውሮፕላን በረራዎችን ለጊዜው እንዲስተጓጎሉ እና ዋና ዋና የመሮጫ መንገዶች እንዲዘጉ ምክንያት ሆኗል፤ ባለስልጣናቱም ጉዳዩን ከባድ የጸጥታ ስጋት ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ባለፉት ወራት ስሱ በሆኑ የጀርመን ስፍራዎች ላይ ድሮኖች መታየታቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ይህ ድርጊት ከውጭ ሀገራት ጋር የተያያዘ የሰርጎ ገብ ጥቃት ሊሆን እንደሚችል ጥርጣሬዎች ተነስተዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Jarman dirree xiyyaaraa Leipzig/Halle cinaatti doonii boombii baatte argamte qorachaa jiru. Qilleensichii kun adeemsa xiyyaaraa yeroodhaaf addaan kan kutte yoo ta'u, qondaaltoonnis haala kanaan nageenya biyyattiirra sodaan cimaan akka jiru ibsaniiru. Jarman keessatti ji'oota darban bakkeewwan xiyyeeffannoo argatan irratti dooniin garagaraa mul'achuun isaanii, shakkii gocha sabotaajii alaa keessa akka jiru taasiseera.

title: Waste workers help winner find binned €1m lottery ticket in Italy
english: A man in Italy accidentally threw away a winning lottery ticket worth €1 million after being mistakenly told it was invalid. After realizing his error, he contacted the local waste collection company, leading to a massive two-day search through truckloads of garbage. Fortunately, sanitation workers successfully located the ticket, allowing the winner to claim his prize.
amharic: በኢጣሊያ የሚኖር አንድ ሰው አንድ ሚሊዮን ዩሮ የደረሰውን የሎተሪ ዕድል ወረቀት በስህተት ቆሻሻ ውስጥ ጥሎት ነበር። ሰውየው ዕድሉ እንደደረሰው ሲያውቅ የቆሻሻ አሰባሳቢ ድርጅቱን በማነጋገር ለሁለት ቀናት በቆሻሻ መኪና ውስጥ ፍለጋ እንዲደረግ አድርጓል። በመጨረሻም የቆሻሻ መጣያ ሰራተኞች የሎተሪ ወረቀቱን በማግኘታቸው እድለኛው ሽልማቱን ለመቀበል በቅቷል።
oromo: Namni tokko Xaaliyaan keessatti liigii maallaqa Yuuroo miiliyoona tokkoo galchise tasumaa kosiitti gatuun isaa erga itti hime booda dogoggora isaatiin akka isaa bade hubate. Erga dogoggora kana hubatee booda, dhaabbata kosiin magaalaa walitti qabuu wajjin hariiroo gochuun guyyoota lamaaf kosii keessatti barbaacha guddaa godhaniiru. Dhuma irratti hojjettoonnii kosiin namtichaan gargaaranii waraqaa liigichaa argachuu danda'an, kunis namtichi miiliyoona tokko akka argatu isa gargaareera.

title: UN rights chief says Iran executed at least 56 people since March
english: The UN High Commissioner for Human Rights reports that Iran has executed at least 56 people since March, many of whom were involved in recent protests. Officials are concerned that the government is using these deaths to intimidate citizens and silence political opposition. Furthermore, the UN highlighted that many of these convictions lack fair trial standards and often rely on forced confessions obtained through torture.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብቶች ከፍተኛ ኮሚሽነር እንዳስታወቁት፣ ኢራን ከመጋቢት ወር ጀምሮ ቢያንስ 56 ሰዎችን የገደለች ሲሆን ከእነዚህም መካከል አብዛኞቹ በቅርቡ በተደረጉ ተቃውሞዎች የተሳተፉ ናቸው። መንግስት እነዚህን የሞት ፍርዶች ተጠቅሞ ህዝቡን ለማስፈራራት እና የተቃውሞ ድምፆችን ለማፈን እየሞከረ መሆኑን ተቋሙ ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም፣ ፍርድ ቤቶቹ ፍትሃዊ ያልሆኑ ሂደቶችን እንደሚከተሉ እና ብዙ ጊዜ በስቃይ የተገኙ መግለጫዎችን መሰረት በማድረግ ውሳኔ እንደሚሰጡ ተመላክቷል።
oromo: Komishinarri Olaanaa Mirga Namoomaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, Iran ji'a Bitootessaa irraa eegalee namoota 56 ol ajjeesuun ishee himameera. Kunis kan ta'e namoota hiriira mormii irratti hirmaatan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuudhaan ummata sodachiisuufi mormii uummataa ukkaamsuuf akka ta'e ibsameera. Kana malees, murtiin kun haqa kan hin qabneefi dararama qaamaa fayyadamuun ragaa dirqiin fudhachuun kan murtaa'e ta'uun isaa komatameera.

title: Pakistan’s Khan in jail for 3 years: PTI rallies over ‘arbitrary detention’
english: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan has marked three years of imprisonment following his removal from office in 2022. Thousands of his supporters held nationwide protests to demand his release, criticizing the legal proceedings as politically motivated and questioning his lack of access to legal counsel and family. Amnesty International has also raised alarms, accusing authorities of systematically denying Khan his right to a fair trial.
amharic: የቀድሞው የፓኪስታን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ካን ከስልጣን ከተወገዱ በኋላ በእስር ቤት ሶስት አመታትን አሳልፈዋል። በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ደጋፊዎቻቸውም መሪውን እንዲፈቱ በመጠየቅ በመላ ሀገሪቱ ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲውና አለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች በእርሳቸው ላይ የቀረቡት ክሶች ፖለቲካዊ መሰረት ያላቸው መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ የፍትህ ሂደቱን ተቃውመዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Paakistaan duraanii Imraan Khaan aangoo irraa erga bu'anii booda waggaa sadiif mana hidhaa turaniiru. Deeggartoonni isaanii kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman mootummaan isaan akka gadhiisu gaafachuun magaalota adda addaatti hiriira bahan. Paartiin isaanii fi dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa adunyaa himannaan isaan irratti dhiyaate siyaasaa irratti kan hundaa'e fi sirni haqaa guutuu akka hin taane ibsaniiru.

title: SpaceX rocket segment to crash into the moon: What happened?
english: A discarded piece of a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, which has been drifting in space since last year, is expected to have collided with the moon at high speed. While the impact will create a new crater on the lunar surface, experts confirm that the event poses no threat to Earth. Scientists plan to use telescopes to study the crash site, which was the result of the rocket segment running out of fuel while performing a deep-space mission.
amharic: ባለፈው ዓመት ከምድር ምህዋር ወጥቶ በጠፈር ሲንሳፈፍ የቆየው የSpaceX Falcon 9 ሮኬት ክፍል በጨረቃ ላይ መከስከሱ ተነግሯል። ይህ ክስተት በምድር ላይ ምንም ዓይነት አደጋ የማያደርስ ቢሆንም በጨረቃ ላይ አዲስ ጉድጓድ እንዲፈጠር ምክንያት ሆኗል። ሳይንቲስቶች የዚህን አደጋ ቦታ በቴሌስኮፕ በመታገዝ ለማጥናት እቅድ ይዘዋል።
oromo: kutaan rookeettii SpaceX Falcon 9 kan waggaa darbee kaasee sarara saayinii keessa bittinnaa'ee ture ji'a irra bu'uu isaa hubatameera. Taateen kun lafa irra miidhaa kan hin geessisne yoo ta'u, ji'a irratti garuu boolla haaraa akka uumu eegama. Saayintistoonni iddoo rookeettichi itti bu'e kana teleeskopii fayyadamuun qorachuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Mohamed Salah lands in Turkiye to fan frenzy ahead of Trabzonspor move
english: Egyptian football icon Mohamed Salah arrived in Istanbul to a massive crowd of supporters while dressed in a Trabzonspor jersey. His arrival signals an imminent transfer to the Turkish Super Lig team. The player has already shared a welcoming message for his new supporters following the warm reception.
amharic: የግብፅ የእግር ኳስ ኮከብ መሀመድ ሳላህ የትራብዞንስፖርን ማሊያ ለብሶ ኢስታንቡል ሲደርስ ከፍተኛ ደስታቸውን በገለጹ በርካታ ደጋፊዎች ታጅቧል። የዚህ ጉብኝቱ ዋና ዓላማ ወደ ቱርክ ሱፐር ሊግ ክለብ ለመዛወር እየተደረገ ያለውን ዝውውር ማጠናቀቅ ነው። ተጫዋቹ ለአዲሱ ክለቡ ደጋፊዎች የእንኳን አደረሳችሁ መልእክት አስተላልፏል።
oromo: Leenjisaa fi taphataan kubbaa miilaa biyya Masrii Mahaammad Saalaah, uffata garee Trabzonspor uffatee gara Istanbul yoo ga’u, deggertoota hedduudhaan simatameera. Daawwannaan isaa kun gara liigii Turkiitti ce'uuf qophii taasisaa jiru kan agarsiisuudha. Taphataan kun erga simannaa ho’aa booda deggertoota isaa haaraaf ergaa gammachuu dabarseera.

title: In Bandar Abbas, the ceasefire never came
english: A 44-year-old single mother living in Bandar Abbas shares her experience of living through constant military strikes despite official reports of a ceasefire. She describes how the city remains under heavy bombardment, targeting critical infrastructure like the Shahid Rajaee Port and local military facilities. Her emotional testimony highlights the deep fear and uncertainty faced by civilians who feel trapped in an ongoing, full-scale war.
amharic: በባንዳር አባስ የምትኖር የ44 ዓመት እናት፣ በከተማዋ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ተደርጓል እየተባለ ቢሆንም፣ በየጊዜው የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶችን በመፍራት የምትኖርበትን አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ታጋራለች። በከተማዋ ዋና ዋና ወደቦች እና ወታደራዊ ተቋማት ላይ እየደረሱ ያሉት ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች ነዋሪዎችን ለከፍተኛ ፍርሃት እና ለህልውና ስጋት እንደዳረጉ ትገልጻለች። በይፋዊ መግለጫዎች እና በእውነተኛው የጦርነት ሁኔታ መካከል ያለው ክፍተት ንጹሃን ዜጎችን በከፍተኛ የጭንቀት ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንደጣላቸው ምስክርነቷ ያሳያል።
oromo: Magala Bandar Abbaas keessatti haati tokko kan umuriin ishee waggaa 44 ta'e, waldhabdeen waraanaa dhaabbateera jedhamus yeroo hunda miidhaan kun itti fufuu isaa ibsiti. Magaalattiin buufataalee gurguddoo fi iddoowwan waraanaa irratti haleellaa cimaa keessa akka jirtu fi kunis jireenya guyyuu irratti sodaa guddaa uumeera. Haati kun akka ibsitti, odeeffannoon mootummaan kennu fi haalli lafa irratti mul'atu wal faallessuun namoota nagaa yaaddoo cimaa keessa akka galche ibsiteetti.

title: Pakistan restricts international media reporting
english: The Pakistani government has introduced new rules requiring foreign media outlets to obtain official permission before reporting from locations outside of Islamabad, Karachi, and Lahore. While officials claim these guidelines are meant to organize administrative processes, critics argue they will hinder independent journalism and increase the spread of misinformation. Journalists and media organizations have strongly opposed the move, stating it will significantly restrict their ability to cover breaking news across the country.
amharic: የፓኪስታን መንግሥት የውጭ ሚዲያ ተቋማት ከኢስላማባድ፣ ከካራቺ እና ከላሆር ውጭ በሌሎች አካባቢዎች ከመዘገባቸዉ በፊት ይፋዊ ፈቃድ እንዲጠይቁ የሚያስገድድ አዲስ ደንብ አውጥቷል። መንግሥት ይህ ደንብ የአስተዳደር ሂደቶችን ለማደራጀት ያለመ ነው ቢልም፣ ተቺዎች ግን ይህ አካሄድ ነጻ ጋዜጠኝነትን እንደሚጎዳ እና የሀሰት መረጃ እንዲስፋፋ እንደሚያደርግ ይከራከራሉ። ጋዜጠኞች እና የሚዲያ ተቋማት ይህንን እርምጃ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ የተቃወሙ ሲሆን፣ በሀገሪቱ ወቅታዊ መረጃዎችን ለመዘገብ ያላቸውን አቅም እንደሚገድብ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Paakistaan miidiyaaleen biyya alaa magaalonni Islamaabaad, Kaaraachii fi Laahor irraa alatti gabaasa akka hin taasifne hayyama akka gaafataniif seera haaraa baaseera. Mootummaan seerrichi hojii bulchiinsaa salphisuuf kan bahe yoo jedhu, mormitoonni garuu tarkaanfichi bilisummaa miidiyaa akka daangessuufi odeeffannoo sobaa akka babal'isu dubbatu. Gaazexeessitootaafi dhaabbileen miidiyaa tarkaanfichatti garmalee kan morman yoo ta'u, kunis gabaasa dhuga-qabeessa ta'e biyyattii keessatti gabaasuuf carraan qaban akka dhiphatu ibsaniiru.

title: Mexican influencer shot dead during livestream
english: Popular Mexican TikTok star César Gastélum was tragically killed after being shot by two individuals on a motorcycle while recording a livestream in Culiacán. Police are currently investigating the incident, though no suspects have been caught and the motive remains unknown. This event highlights the growing concern over targeted violence against social media influencers in the region, which has been exacerbated by ongoing cartel conflicts.
amharic: ታዋቂው የቲክቶክ ተጠቃሚ ሴሳር ጋስቴሉም በኩሊያካን ከተማ የቀጥታ ስርጭት እያደረገ ሳለ በሞተር ሳይክል በደረሱ ሁለት ሰዎች ተገድሏል። ፖሊስ ግድያውን እየመረመረ ቢሆንም እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ተጠርጣሪ አልተያዘም፣ የጥቃቱም ምክንያት አልታወቀም። ይህ ክስተት በሜክሲኮ ማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ተፅእኖ ፈጣሪዎች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን የጥቃት ስጋት የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ ሁኔታውም በአካባቢው በሚንቀሳቀሱ የወንጀል ቡድኖች ግጭት የተባባሰ ነው።
oromo: beektotni miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti beekamu, César Gastélum, magaala Culiacán keessatti yeroo viidiyoo qophee (livestream) godhuu turetti namoota lamaan mootor saayikiliin dhufaniin ajjeefame. Poolisiin qorannoo jalqabeus, namootni ajjeechaa kana raawwatan hanga ammaatti kan hin qabamneefi sababni isaas hin beekamne. Haalli kun miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti beekamtii qabaniif balaan isaan mudachaa jiru kan dabalaa dhufe ta'uu kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, kunis walitti bu'iinsa garee yakkaatiin kan wal qabatuudha.

title: Lebanon and Israel still split over disarming Hezbollah at Rome talks
english: Lebanon and Israel are currently engaged in US-brokered talks in Rome to finalize a ceasefire and organize an Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanon. While there has been some progress, a major disagreement persists regarding the disarmament of Hezbollah and how to effectively manage security in key border areas. Both sides are negotiating the involvement of a third party to oversee the troop movements and ensure the Lebanese army can take control of strategic sites.
amharic: ሊባኖስ እና እስራኤል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነትን ለማጠናከር እና እስራኤል ከደቡብ ሊባኖስ የምትወጣበትን መንገድ ለመቀየስ በሮም እየተወያዩ ይገኛሉ። በሂደቱ ላይ የተወሰነ መሻሻል ቢታይም፣ የሂዝቦላህን ትጥቅ መፍታት እና በድንበር አካባቢ ያለውን የጸጥታ ሁኔታ እንዴት መቆጣጠር እንደሚቻል በሚለው ጉዳይ ላይ ትልቅ አለመግባባት አለ። ሁለቱም ወገኖች የእስራኤልን ጦር መውጣት ለመከታተል እና የሊባኖስ ጦር ስልታዊ ቦታዎችን እንዲቆጣጠር ለማስቻል ገለልተኛ አካልን ስለማሳተፍ እየተደራደሩ ነው።
oromo: Libanoos fi Israa'el walii galtee waraana dhaabuu fi humnoonni Israa'el kibba Libaanoos irraa akka bahaniif Roomaatti mari'achaa jiru. Mariin kun garaagarummaa guddaa kan qabu yoo ta'u, keessattuu hidhannoo garee Hizbollaa hiikuu fi nageenya daangaa eeguu irratti walii galuu hin dandeenye. Gareewwan lamaanuu humnoonni Israa'el bahuu isaanii fi raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Libaanoos iddoo buufataalee sirnaan to'achuu isaanii hordofuuf qaama sadaffaa giddu galeessa ta'e tokko qaxaruuf mari'achaa jiru.

title: Vozinha moves on from World Cup, says ‘Colo-Colo is the best moment’
english: Cape Verdean goalkeeper Vozinha has officially joined the Chilean football club Colo-Colo. After his experience at the World Cup, the player expressed that joining this renowned team marks the highlight of his professional club career. He is now focused on his future with the new club rather than his past international achievements.
amharic: የኬፕ ቨርዴ ብሔራዊ ቡድን ግብ ጠባቂ ቮዚንሃ በቺሊው ታዋቂ ክለብ ኮሎ-ኮሎ በይፋ መፈረሙ ተገለጸ። ተጫዋቹ በአለም ዋንጫ ላይ የነበረውን ተሳትፎ ትቶ አዲሱን ክለብ መቀላቀሉ በሙያው የላቀው ምዕራፍ እንደሆነ ተናግሯል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ትኩረቱን በአዲሱ ክለቡ ቆይታው ላይ አድርጓል።
oromo: Gol-eezii biyya Keppe Verde kan ta'e Voziinhaan, kilabii beekamaa biyya Chiilii kan ta'e Kolo-Kolo waliin waligaltee mallatteesseera. Taphataan kun dorgommii Waancaa Addunyaa booda, kilabii kana makamuun isaa jireenya isaatiif yeroo olaanaa akka ta'e ibseera. Amma xiyyeeffannaan isaa hojii gara fuulduraa kilabii haaraa kana waliin qabu irratti ta'a.

title: Israeli raid deepens fears across West Bank refugee camps
english: Israeli military forces have intensified their operations within West Bank refugee camps, causing significant alarm among the local population. Reports indicate that these ongoing raids are accompanied by heightened violence and stricter movement restrictions. This escalation has created a climate of intense fear and instability for those living in the affected areas.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ የስደተኞች ካምፖች ውስጥ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻቸውን በማስፋፋታቸው በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥረዋል። እነዚህ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እየጨመረ ከመጣው የጉልበት እርምጃ እና የመንቀሳቀስ ገደቦች ጋር ተያይዘው እንደሚከናወኑ ተዘግቧል። ይህ ሁኔታ በተጎዱት አካባቢዎች የሚኖሩ ሰዎችን ደህንነት በእጅጉ አሳሳቢ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el buufataalee godaantotaa kan biyya West Bank keessatti duula waraanaa babal'isuun isaanii uummata naannichaa biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira. Raayidiiwwan kun yeroo hunda irra deddeebi'anii kan gaggeeffaman yoo ta'u, kana waliin wal-qabatee miidhaan fi daangaan sochii uummataa dabalaa jiraachuun gabaafameera. Haalli kun jiraattota naannichaa biratti sodaa guddaa fi tasgabbii dhabuu hammaataa fiduu isaati.

title: India’s severe monsoon season causes more than 100 deaths since July
english: Heavy monsoon rains and subsequent landslides have claimed over 100 lives across India since July, causing widespread displacement and damage to homes. While these rains are vital for agriculture, experts warn that climate change and the El Nino phenomenon are making the weather patterns increasingly unpredictable and dangerous. Several states, including Assam, Kerala, and Jammu and Kashmir, have been severely affected by the flooding and lightning strikes.
amharic: ከሐምሌ ወር ጀምሮ በሕንድ ውስጥ የጣለው ከፍተኛ የמוንሶን ዝናብ ባስከተለው የመሬት መንሸራተት እና ጎርፍ ከ100 በላይ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የዝናብ መጠኑ ለግብርና አስፈላጊ ቢሆንም፣ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ እና ኤል ኒኖ የተባለው ክስተት የአየር ሁኔታውን እጅግ አደገኛና ያልተጠበቀ እንዲሆን አድርገውታል። በተለይም የአሳም፣ የኬረላ እና የጃሙ እና ካሽሚር ግዛቶች በጎርፍ እና በመብረቅ አደጋ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Hagayyaa irraa eegalee roobni cimaa fi lolaan biyya Indiyaa keessatti mudate lubbuu namoota 100 ol galaafateera, akkasumas namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman mana isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Roobni kun qonnaaf barbaachisaa ta'us, jijjiiramni qilleensaa fi jijjiiramni haala qilleensaa 'El Nino' jedhamu roobicha caalaatti balaa fi tasa kan godhu ta'uu ogeeyyoonni ibsaniiru. Godinaalee akka Assam, Kerala fi Jammu fi Kashmir keessatti balaa lolaa fi qaqqaawwee bakakkaan namoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru.

title: How Israeli restrictions on Palestinians’ movement break up the West Bank
english: Israeli military restrictions, such as checkpoints and road blocks, have severely fragmented the West Bank, making travel difficult and unpredictable for Palestinians. Over several decades, infrastructure changes and the expansion of settlements have transformed simple journeys into time-consuming and hazardous ordeals. These policies significantly disrupt daily life and economic movement while failing to enhance regional security.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ገደቦች፣ እንደ ኬላዎች እና የመንገድ መዝጊያዎች ያሉ እርምጃዎች፣ የዌስት ባንክን መሬት በመበታተን በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ ከባድ የጉዞ ችግር ፈጥረዋል። ባለፉት ስድስት አሥርት ዓመታት የታዩ የመሰረተ ልማት ለውጦች እና የሰፈራ መስፋፋቶች ቀደም ሲል ቀላል የነበሩ ጉዞዎችን አድካሚና አደገኛ አድርገዋቸዋል። እነዚህ አካሄዶች የሰዎችን የዕለት ተዕለት እንቅስቃሴ እና የኢኮኖሚ ሁኔታ በእጅጉ የሚጎዱ ሲሆን፣ ለቀጠናው ደህንነት መሻሻልም ምንም አስተዋጽኦ አላደረጉም።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el daangaa fi sakatta'iinsa manneen jireenyaa irratti godhuun, naannoo Weest Baanki bakka bakkaatti diiguudhaan sochiin uummata Palastayinii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumeera. Waggoota dheeraaf babal'inni bu'uraalee misoomaa fi babal'inni iddoo qubannaa Israa'elootaa, imala salphaa ture gara adeemsa dadhabsiisaa fi balaa qabutti jijjiireera. Hojiin kun jireenya guyyaa guyyaa fi sochiin dinagdee irratti miidhaa guddaa kan geessisu yoo ta'u, tasgabbii naannichaas hin fooyyessine.

title: Perez Hilton recovering in hospital after reports he self-harmed during livestream
english: Celebrity blogger Perez Hilton is currently receiving medical care in a hospital following a mental health crisis that occurred during a live broadcast on TikTok. After concerned viewers alerted authorities to signs of self-harm, police arrived at his Miami home to ensure his safety. Officials confirmed that the situation was managed through de-escalation techniques, and mental health professionals are now working to support Hilton and his family.
amharic: የታዋቂው የብሎግ ባለቤት ፔሬዝ ሂልተን በቲክቶክ ላይ የቀጥታ ስርጭት እያደረገ ሳለ ባጋጠመው የአእምሮ ጤና ቀውስ ምክንያት ሆስፒታል ገብቶ ህክምና እየተደረገለት ነው። ተመልካቾች በቪዲዮው ላይ ለራሱ ጉዳት እንዳደረሰ በመጠራጠራቸው ለፖሊስ ጥቆማ ሰጥተዋል፣ ይህም ባለስልጣናት ወደ ቤቱ እንዲሄዱ አድርጓል። የአካባቢው ፖሊስ ሁኔታውን በሰላማዊ መንገድ መቆጣጠሩን የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ የአእምሮ ጤና ባለሙያዎችም ለሂልተንና ለቤተሰቡ ድጋፍ እየሰጡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Bloggara beekamaa Perez Hilton jedhamu guyyaa kaleessa vidiyoo live (tamsaasa kallattii) TikTok irra ture irratti rakkoo fayyaa sammuu mudateen walqabatee hospitaala galuun yaalama jira. Daawwattoonni vidiyoo kanaa of miidhuu isaa hubatanii poolisii beeksisuun isaanii, humnoonni nageenyaa mana isaatti qaqqabanii akka inni tasgabbaa'uuf gargaaraniiru. Poolisiin Miyaamii akka ibsetti, haalli kun karaa naga qabeessa ta'een kan too'atame yoo ta'u, ogeeyyonni fayyaa sammuus maatii isaa fi isaaf deeggarsa barbaachisaa ta'e gochaa jiru.

title: Police raid Starbucks Korea headquarters over 'Tank Day' fiasco
english: South Korean police searched the Starbucks headquarters following a public outcry over a marketing campaign perceived as mocking a sensitive historical tragedy. The promotion was criticized for using imagery and language that many felt disrespected victims of the 1980 Gwangju Uprising and other past abuses. In response to the backlash and a major decline in sales, the company issued apologies, fired its CEO, and mandated historical training for its employees.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ ፖሊስ ስታርባክስ ኩባንያ በታሪክ አጋጣሚ ለተከሰተ የንግድ ማስታወቂያ ግድፈት ከባድ ትችት በመሰንዘሩ ዋና መስሪያ ቤቱን ፈትሸዋል። ማስታወቂያው እ.ኤ.አ በ1980 በጓንግጁ የተካሄደውን የዴሞክራሲ ንቅናቄ ሰለባዎች የሚንቅ ተደርጎ በመታየቱ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። ኩባንያው ለተፈጠረው ስህተት ይቅርታ ከመጠየቁም በላይ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚውን ከስራ አሰናብቷል እንዲሁም ሰራተኞቹን በታሪክ ጉዳዮች ላይ የግንዛቤ ስልጠና እንዲወስዱ አድርጓል።
oromo: Poolisiin Koriyaa Kibbaa, Starbucks hubannoo seenaa qabu kan miidhuu danda'u of keessatti qabata jedhamee shakkamee irratti qorannoo gaggeessuuf gamoo waajjira isaanii sakatta'eera. Gurgurtaa Starbucks kanneen yeroo darbe keessa seenaa gaddisiisaa ta'e akka waan tuffatutti ilaalamuun uummata biratti mufannaa guddaa uumee ture. Starbucks dogoggora kanaaf dhiifama gaafachuu fi gurguddoo hojii isaa irraa kaasuun alatti, hojjettoota isaa seenaa biyyattii irratti barnoota akka argatan dirqisiiseera.

title: Russian attacks kill 17, exploiting Ukraine’s lack of missile interceptors
english: A massive Russian overnight assault involving nearly 150 missiles and drones struck civilian warehouses and infrastructure near Kyiv, resulting in at least 17 deaths. President Zelenskyy stated that the high casualty count was avoidable if Ukraine had received sufficient missile interceptors from its allies. He condemned the strikes as deliberate attacks on non-military logistics and commercial facilities.
amharic: ሩሲያ በኪየቭ እና አካባቢው ባደረሰችው መጠነ ሰፊ የሮኬት እና የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 17 ሰዎች መሞታቸውን ተከትሎ የዩክሬን ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ በምዕራባውያን አጋሮች የሚደረግ የፀረ-ሮኬት አቅርቦት መዘግየት ለዚህ ጥፋት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። የሩሲያ ጥቃት በዋናነት ያነጣጠረው በሲቪል መጋዘኖች፣ በምግብ ማከማቻዎች እና በሌሎች መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንቱ እንደገለጹት አስፈላጊው የመከላከል አቅም ቢኖር ኖሮ የብዙ ሰዎችን ህይወት ማዳን ይቻል ነበር።
oromo: Raashiyaan magaala Kieviifi naannoo ishee irratti haleellaa rookeettii fi diroonii cimaa raawwatteen namoonni 17 du'aniiru. Pirezidaanti Zeleniskiin haleellaan kun kan qaqqabe gargaarsi meeshaalee qilleensa irraa ittisuu biyyoota michoota irraa dhangala'uun isaa hir'achuu irraa akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Haleellaan kun bakkeewwan qulqulluu sivilii, kutaalee kuusaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu fi meeshaaleen ittisaa kun jiraatanii utuu ta'ee lubbuun nama baay'ee ooluu akka danda'u himaniiru.

title: Toppled Bangladesh leader Sheikh Hasina to speak today: What we can expect
english: Former Bangladeshi leader Sheikh Hasina, who has been living in exile in India since her 2024 ouster, is scheduled to make a rare public statement via videolink. She faces a death sentence in her home country for her role in the violent suppression of student-led protests that resulted in many deaths. While the Bangladeshi government has blocked local media from broadcasting her remarks, she is expected to challenge the charges against her and discuss her potential political future.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 ከስልጣን የተባረሩት እና በህንድ በስደት የሚገኙት የቀድሞ የባንግላዲሽ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሀሲና በቪዲዮ ሊንክ በኩል በይፋዊ መግለጫ ሊሰጡ ነው። በባንግላዲሽ በነበረው የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ወቅት በወሰዱት የኃይል እርምጃ የሞት ፍርድ የተፈረደባቸው ሀሲና፣ በሀገራቸው የሚዲያ ስርጭት ቢታገድባቸውም በንግግራቸው ክሱን እንደሚቃወሙ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ክስተት ከሁለት አመት የፖለቲካ መገለል በኋላ የተፈጠረ ነው፣ ይህም የቀድሞዋን መሪ ወደ ፖለቲካ መድረክ የመመለስ ፍላጎት ሊያሳይ ይችላል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Bangladish kanaan dura turan Sheikh Hasina bara 2024 aangoorraa bu’anii Hindi keessatti baqattummaan kan jiraatan, yeroo dheeraa booda haasaa iddoo ummataa godhuuf qophaa’aniiru. Hasina mormii barattootaa irratti tarkaanfii fudhataniin lubbuun namaa akka darbu taasisuun himatamanii biyyattii isaaniitti adabbii du'aa itti murameera. Mootummaan Bangladish haasaa isaanii miidiyaaleen biyyattii keessaa akka hin dabarsine dhorkus, inni isaanii himannaa irratti dhiyaate kana mormuufi gara fuulduraatti gara siyaasaatti deebi'uu danda'an irratti akka xiyyeeffatan eegama.

title: Michigan, Missouri, Washington primary elections: Key takeaways
english: Primary elections in Michigan, Missouri, and Washington have highlighted an ongoing ideological divide within the Democratic Party regarding US policy on Israel. In Michigan, progressive Abdul El-Sayed and moderate Haley Stevens are in a tight race for the Senate nomination, which has become a significant test for the party's future direction. Because Michigan is a crucial swing state, the outcome of this contest is being closely watched as a bellwether for the upcoming November general election.
amharic: በሚቺጋን፣ ሚዙሪ እና ዋሽንግተን የተካሄዱት የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫዎች በእስራኤል ጉዳይ ላይ በዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ ያለውን የፖለቲካ ልዩነት አሳይተዋል። በሚቺጋን፣ ለሴኔት እጩነት በሂደት አራማጁ አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ እና በመካከለኛው መስመር ተከታይዋ ሄይሊ ስቲቨንስ መካከል ያለው ፉክክር ለፓርቲው የወደፊት አቅጣጫ ወሳኝ ፈተና ሆኗል። ሚቺጋን ወሳኝ የሆነ የድምፅ አሰጣጥ ለውጥ የሚታይበት ግዛት በመሆኑ፣ የዚህ ምርጫ ውጤት ለህዳሩ አጠቃላይ ምርጫ እንደ ዋነኛ አመላካች እየታየ ነው።
oromo: Filannoon jalqabaa Michigan, Missouri fi Washington keessatti gaggeeffame, dhimma Israa'el irratti garee Dimokiraatota keessatti walitti bu'iinsa yaadaa jiru ifa baaseera. Michigan keessatti, Abdul El-Sayed kan jijjiirama barbaadu fi Haley Stevens kan giddu-galeessa taate gidduutti kan godhame dorgommiin paartichaaf qormaata guddaa ta'ee jira. Michigan naannoo filannoo wal madaalaa taate waan ta'eef, bu'aan dorgommii kanaa filannoo guutuu Sadaasaa dhufuuf mallattoo cimaa ta'ee ilaallamaa jira.

title: Trump hails progress but warned Iran of ‘hard hit’ if no deal reached
english: President Donald Trump stated that some progress has been achieved in diplomatic relations with Iran. However, he cautioned that the country will face severe military consequences if they fail to reach a formal agreement. Trump also revealed that the United States previously canceled a major planned military strike on Iran after the nation signaled an interest in discussions.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር ባለው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት የተወሰነ መሻሻል ታይቷል ብለዋል። ነገር ግን ስምምነት ላይ ካልተደረሰ ኢራን ከባድ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድባት አስጠንቅቀዋል። ትራምፕ አክለውም ኢራን ለድርድር ፍላጎት ማሳየቷን ተከትሎ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ልትፈጽም የነበረውን መጠነ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት መሰረዟን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp hariiroo Iiraan wajjin qaban keessatti tarkaanfii gaariin mul’achuu isaa ibsaniiru. Ta’us, yoo waliigaltee irratti hin ga’amne ta’e, Iiraan miidhaa waraanaa cimaa akka ishee mudatu akeekkachiisaniiru. Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Iiraan mariif fedhii agarsiisuu isheetiin walqabatee, Ameerikaan miidhaa waraanaa guddaa ishee irratti raawwachuuf karoorfate ture dhaabuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Cape Verde’s World Cup hero, social media sensation Vozinha joins Colo-Colo
english: Cape Verdean goalkeeper Vozinha has signed with the historic Chilean club Colo-Colo following his impressive performance at the World Cup. The 40-year-old athlete expressed his excitement to join such a prestigious team after years of playing in smaller leagues. His successful run in the tournament, which included holding major nations to draws, helped boost his international profile and secure this new opportunity.
amharic: የኬፕ ቨርዴው ግብ ጠባቂ ቮዚንሃ በዓለም ዋንጫው ላይ ባሳየው አስደናቂ ብቃት ምክንያት ወደ ቺሊው ታዋቂ ክለብ ኮሎ-ኮሎ ተዘዋውሯል። የ40 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች ከዚህ ቀደም በትንንሽ ሊጎች ሲጫወት ከቆየ በኋላ አሁን ትልቅ ክለብ በመቀላቀሉ የተሰማውን ደስታ ገልጿል። በዓለም ዋንጫው ለሀገሩ ያሳየው ጥሩ እንቅስቃሴ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ትኩረትን እንዲያገኝ እና ይህን አዲስ ዕድል እንዲያገኝ አስችሎታል።
oromo: Golkeepperiin biyya Keeyp Veerdee Vozinha, tapha isa waa’ee Waancaa Addunyaa irratti agarsiise booda gara kilabii beekamaa biyya Chiilii kan ta'e Colo-Colo tti makameera. Umriin isaa waggaa 40 kan ta'e atileetichi, waggoota dheeraaf liigii xiqqaa keessatti taphataa erga turee booda kilabii guddaa akkanaa waliin walitti makamuun isaa isa gammachiiseera. Taphoota Waancaa Addunyaa irratti biyyoota gurguddoo irratti agarsiise fi sadarkaa isaa guddisuun, carraa kana akka argatu isa gargaareera.

title: Pakistan and Uganda athletes ‘missing’ after Commonwealth Games
english: Police in Scotland are investigating the disappearance of several athletes from Pakistan and Uganda who failed to return home following the conclusion of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. Reports indicate that some of these athletes may be intending to seek asylum. This incident follows a historical pattern of participants vanishing during international sporting events held in nations like Britain and Australia.
amharic: በግላስጎው በተካሄደው የኮመንዌልዝ ጨዋታዎች ማጠናቀቂያ ላይ ወደ አገራቸው ያልተመለሱ የፓኪስታን እና የዩጋንዳ አትሌቶች መጥፋት ጉዳይ በስኮትላንድ ፖሊስ እየተጣራ ነው። አንዳንዶቹ አትሌቶች ጥገኝነት ለመጠየቅ እንዳቀዱ ተነግሯል። መሰል ክስተቶች ቀደም ሲል በእንግሊዝ እና በአውስትራሊያ በተካሄዱ ዓለም አቀፍ የስፖርት ውድድሮች ላይም ይስተዋሉ ነበር።
oromo: Poolisiin Iskotland garee ispoortii Paakistaanii fi Yugaandaa irraa taphattoonni tokko tokko tapha Komoniweelzi Gilaasgowitti erga xumuramee booda gara biyyatti deebi'uu diduun isaanii qorachaa jira. Iyyattoonni kun sagantaa tapha kana booda bakka hin beekamnetti kan badaniif, dawoo gaafachuuf karoorfatanii ta'uu mala jedhamee shakkama. Akkuma kanaan dura biyyoota akka Biriiteenii fi Awustiraaliyaatti taphoota idil-addunyaa irratti mul'achaa ture, yeroo ammas waa'een atileetota badanii kun xiyyeeffannaa argatee jira.

title: Nigeria cannot build safe schools in unsafe communities
english: Despite the implementation of the Safe Schools Initiative, Nigerian students continue to face abduction risks because the program focuses primarily on school infrastructure rather than surrounding regional security. Although the government has expanded safety measures since the Chibok tragedy, recent kidnappings demonstrate that school protection remains ineffective when the broader environment is dangerous. Experts suggest that true safety for students will only be achieved by addressing the persistent lack of security in the communities beyond school grounds.
amharic: የደህንነት ትምህርት ቤቶች ተነሳሽነት ቢኖርም፣ የኒጄሪያ ተማሪዎች በዋናነት በትምህርት ቤት መሰረተ ልማት ላይ እንጂ በአካባቢው ሰፊ የፀጥታ ሁኔታ ላይ ትኩረት ባለማድረጉ ለጠለፋ ተጋላጭ ናቸው። ከቺቦክ አደጋ ወዲህ መንግስት የደህንነት እርምጃዎችን ቢያሰፋም፣ የቅርብ ጊዜ ጠለፋዎች ትምህርት ቤቶች ብቻቸውን ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ አለመሆኑን ያሳያሉ። ለተማሪዎች ዘላቂ ሰላም የሚገኘው በትምህርት ቤቶች ውጪ ባሉ ማህበረሰቦች ውስጥ ያለውን የፀጥታ ችግር በመፍታት ብቻ እንደሆነ ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Sagantaan manneen barnootaa eegumsa qabaatan kunneen utuu jiranii, barattoonni Naayijeeriyaa haala nageenyaa naannawaa isaanirratti xiyyeeffannoon waan hin kennamneef ammallee butamuuf saaxilamu. Mootummaan erga balaa Chibok booda tarkaanfii nageenyaa babal'iseellee, butiinii dhihoo kun manneen barnootaa kophaatti eeguun ga'aa akka hin taane agarsiisa. Ogeeyyoonni akka jedhanitti, nageenyi dhugaan kan mirkanaa'u naannoo manneen barnootaa alatti argamu keessatti nageenya buusuun qofaadha.

title: Alcaraz withdraws from Cincinnati event as doubts grow over US Open defence
english: Tennis star Carlos Alcaraz has withdrawn from the Cincinnati Open due to a persistent wrist injury. This latest setback raises significant concerns regarding his ability to compete in the upcoming US Open. While the seven-time Grand Slam champion has been training, he has not yet confirmed his status for any remaining tournaments before the major event.
amharic: የቴኒስ ኮከቡ ካርሎስ አልካራዝ በእጁ ላይ በደረሰበት ጉዳት ምክንያት በሲንሲናቲ ኦፕን ውድድር ላይ እንደማይካፈል አስታውቋል። ይህ ክስተት በቅርቡ በሚጀምረው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር ላይ የመሳተፍ ችሎታው ላይ ጥርጣሬ ፈጥሯል። አትሌቱ ምንም እንኳን ልምምድ እያደረገ ቢሆንም፣ ወደ ዋናው ውድድር ከመግባቱ በፊት በሌሎች ውድድሮች ስለመሳተፉ እስካሁን የተረጋገጠ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Taphataan tenisi beekamaan Kaarloos Alkaaraaz miidhaa harka isaarra ga'een walqabatee dorgommii 'Cincinnati Open' irraa akka of duuba deebise beekameera. Mudannoon kun dorgommii 'US Open' dhufuuf jedhurratti hirmaachuun isaa shakkiin akka uumamu godheera. Kaarloos taphoota gurguddoo torba injifate kun leenjii cimaa gochaa kan jiru ta'us, dorgommiiwwan gurguddoon kun jalqabuu dura taphoota biroo irratti hirmaachuuf murteessuu isaa hanga ammaatti ifa hin godhe.

title: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic primary for Senate, NBC projects
english: Progressive candidate Abdul El-Sayed has secured the Democratic nomination for the US Senate in Michigan after defeating Congresswoman Haley Stevens. Despite significant financial opposition from pro-Israel groups, El-Sayed advanced to the general election where he will face Republican Mike Rogers. If successful in November, El-Sayed would become the first Muslim senator in American history.
amharic: አብዱል ኤል-ሳዬድ በሚቺጋን የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ የሴኔት ምርጫ አሸናፊ በመሆን ለህዳር ወር አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ማለፋቸው ተገለጸ። ተወዳዳሪው በእስራኤል ደጋፊ ቡድኖች ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ተጽዕኖ ቢደረግባቸውም ድሉን መቀዳጀት ችለዋል። በህዳር ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ የሚያሸንፉ ከሆነ፣ በአሜሪካ ታሪክ የመጀመሪያው ሙስሊም ሴናተር ይሆናሉ።
oromo: Abdul El-Sayed filannoo duraa kan paartii Dimokiraatawaa kan Michigan keessatti sagalee baay'ee argachuun injifatan. Morkataa isaanii kan ta'an Haley Stevens garee Israa'el deggeran irraa deggarsa maallaqaa cimaa argatanis, El-Sayed injifannoo argachuu danda'aniiru. Yoo baatii Sadaasaa dhufu injifatan, seenaa Ameerikaa keessatti senaatarri Muslima ta'an jalqabaa ta'u.

title: The yearly mild weather spell that brings Yemen’s coast back to life
english: The annual Al-Baldah climate phenomenon brings a temporary period of refreshing, cool weather to the coastal city of Mukalla in Yemen. This event attracts thousands of visitors to the beaches, providing a much-needed escape from the region's usual intense summer heat. For local residents, the influx of tourists creates a rare economic opportunity to earn income through small businesses like food stalls, offering a brief respite from the hardships of the ongoing conflict.
amharic: በየዓመቱ የሚከሰተው የአል-ባልዳህ የተፈጥሮ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ በየመን የባህር ጠረፍ ላይ የምትገኘው ሙካላ ከተማ ለጥቂት ሳምንታት ቀዝቃዛና አስደሳች የአየር ንብረት እንዲኖራት ያደርጋል። ይህ ወቅት በርካታ ጎብኚዎችን ወደ አካባቢው በመሳብ ከተማዋን ህያው የሚያደርግ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎችም በምግብ መሸጫ እና በተለያዩ ስራዎች ተጨማሪ ገቢ የሚያገኙበት አጋጣሚን ይፈጥራል። ይህ ክስተት በጦርነትና በችግር ለሚሰቃዩት የየመን ህዝቦች ለአጭር ጊዜም ቢሆን ከኑሮ ውጥረት የሚላቀቁበት ተስፋ ሰጪ ጊዜ ሆኖ አገልግሏል።
oromo: Hawaanxoon 'Al-Baldah' jedhamu kan waggaa waggaan uumamu, magaalaa Mukalla kan Yamanitti argamtu irratti yeroo gabaabaaf qilleensa gaarii fi qabbanaa'aa fida. Taateen kun namoota kumaatamaan lakka'aman gara qarqara galaanichaatti hawwatee, ho'a guyyaa daran cimaa ta'e irraa boqonnaa akka argatan taasisa. Jiraattonni magaalaa kunis, namoota hedduu kana fayyadamudhaan nyaata fi dhugaatii gurgurachaa galii argachuuf carraa guddaa argatu; kunis waraana biyyattii keessa jiruun miidhamaniif gargaarsa xiqqoo ta'us gammachuu fi fayyadama dinagdee kenna.

title: Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv kills two and injures others, officials say
english: A major Russian ballistic missile and drone attack on Kyiv and its surrounding areas has resulted in two deaths and at least 24 injuries. The overnight assault targeted civilian neighborhoods, causing significant damage and leaving authorities concerned that residents may remain trapped beneath collapsed structures. In response to the intensifying conflict, Ukrainian officials are calling for additional defensive missile systems to better protect their cities from these aerial strikes.
amharic: ሩሲያ በኪየቭ እና በአካባቢዋ ባደረሰችው የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል እና የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ቢያንስ 24 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። በሌሊት በተፈጸመው በዚህ ጥቃት የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች በመመታታቸው የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በፍርስራሽ ስር የተጠመዱ ሰዎች ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ ስጋት አላቸው። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት በከተማዎቻቸው ላይ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የከፍተኛ ጥቃት ለመመከት ተጨማሪ የመከላከያ መሳሪያዎችን ለማግኘት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Raashiyaan magaalaa Kiyevii fi naannawa ishee irratti miisaayilaa fi dooniiwwan hidhataniin haleellaa geggeessiten lubbuun namoota lamaa yoo darbu, namoonni 24 ol ammoo madaa’aniiru. Haleellaa halkan keessa raawwatame kanaan manneen jireenyaa fi bu’uuraaleenalee misoomaa miidhamaniiru; abbootii aangoo mootummaa birattis namoonni diigamuu manaa jala hafan ta’uu danda’uun sodaan uumameera. Rakkoo kana dhaabsisuuf, mootummaan Yukreenii magaaloowwan ishee haleellaa kanarraa ittisuuf meeshaalee waraanaa dabalataa akka argattu gargaarsa gaafachaa jirti.

title: Bolivia sends troops to stop Brazilian gang violence along border
english: The Bolivian government has deployed over 200 soldiers and police officers to the border region shared with Brazil. This move aims to curb a surge in violence resulting from territorial conflicts between rival Brazilian criminal organizations fighting over drug smuggling routes. At least nine people have reportedly lost their lives due to these ongoing clashes.
amharic: የቦሊቪያ መንግስት ከብራዚል ጋር በሚዋሰነው ድንበር ላይ የተከሰተውን የጥቃት ማዕበል ለመቆጣጠር ከ200 በላይ ወታደሮችን እና ፖሊሶችን አሰማርቷል። እርምጃው የተወሰደው በብራዚል የወንጀል ቡድኖች መካከል የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር መንገዶችን ለመቆጣጠር በሚደረግ ግጭት ምክንያት ነው። በዚህ ግጭት እስካሁን ቢያንስ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች መሞታቸው ታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Boliviyaa daangaa biyyattiin Birazil waliin qabdu irratti jeequmsa uumame to’achuuf waraanaafi poolisoota 200 ol ergeera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame gareewwan yakkaa Birazil gidduutti karaa gurgurtaa qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu to’achuuf wal loluun walitti bu’iinsa uumameef dha. Walitti bu’iinsa kana kanaan namoonni sagal ol ta’an du’aniiru.

title: North Korea’s Kim Yo Jong issues military threat over Japan missile test
english: Kim Yo Jong, the sister of North Korea's leader, has issued a sharp warning against Japan following its recent test of a U.S.-made Tomahawk cruise missile. She accused Tokyo of shifting toward an aggressive military stance and blamed the United States for supporting this buildup. Pyongyang indicated it would respond with new military actions, suggesting that these joint defense activities have placed regional security at greater risk.
amharic: የሰሜን ኮሪያው መሪ እህት ኪም ዮ ጆንግ፣ ጃፓን አሜሪካ ሰራሽ የሆነውን ቶማሃውክ የተሰኘ ክሩዝ ሚሳይል መሞከሯን ተከትሎ ጠንካራ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። ጃፓን የመከላከል አቅሟን ወደ ጥቃት የመፈጸም አቅም እያሳደገች እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ ለአሜሪካ ድጋፍ ተጠያቂ አድርገዋል። ሰሜን ኮሪያ ለዚህ ድርጊት ተገቢውን ወታደራዊ ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ በመግለጽ፣ ይህ የጃፓን እና የአሜሪካ ጥምረት ለቀጠናው ደህንነት ስጋት እንደሆነ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: obboleettiin geggeessaa biyya Koriyaa Kaabaa Kim Yo Jong, biyyi Jaappaan mishaayila 'Tomahawk' jedhamu kan Ameerikaa irraa bittee qorannoo taasisuun ishee booda, biyyattii irratti akeekkachiisa cimaa dabarsiteetti. Jaappaan gara duulaatti ce’aa akka jirtu himattee, guddina waraanaa kanaaf Ameerikaan itti gaafatamtuu akka taate himteetti. Koriyaan Kaabaa tarkaanfiiwwan Jaappaan fudhachaa jirtu kanaaf deebii waraanaa akka kennitu ibsuun, walta’iinsi kun nageenya naannichaa balaa irra buuseera jetteetti.

title: Protesters demand answers from ICE after second man dies at Delaney Hall
english: Demonstrators are calling for transparency from immigration authorities following the death of a 41-year-old Salvadoran man at the Delaney Hall detention center in New Jersey. The man, Edwin Lopez-Cornejo, passed away after experiencing a medical crisis while in custody. This incident marks the second death at the facility, prompting increased public concern and demands for accountability.
amharic: በኒው ጀርሲ በሚገኘው የዴላኒ ሆል እስር ቤት የ41 ዓመት ኤል ሳልቫዶራዊ ሰው ህይወት ማለፉን ተከትሎ ተቃዋሚዎች ከኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ማብራሪያ እየጠየቁ ነው። ኤድዊን ሎፔዝ-ኮርኔጆ በተያዘበት ወቅት በደረሰበት የጤና እክል ምክንያት ህይወቱ አልፏል። ይህ በግቢው ውስጥ የተመዘገበ ሁለተኛው የሞት ክስተት በመሆኑ፣ ህዝባዊ ተቃውሞና ተጠያቂነትን የመጠየቅ እንቅስቃሴ ጨምሯል።
oromo: Namni umriin isaa waggaa 41 ta'e kan biyya El-Saalvaador, bakka qabsoo isaanii kan Delaney Hall, New Jersey keessatti erga du'ee booda, namoonni mormiin dhageessisan aangessitoota imigireeshinii irraa ibsa barbaadu. Edwin Lopez-Cornejo iddoo qabsoo sanaa keessatti rakkoo fayyaa mudateen du'uu isaa gabaafameera. Kun du'a lammaffaa bakka kana keessatti raawwatame waan ta'eef, uummatni mormii isaa guddisuun gaafatamummaan akka jiraatu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Israel approves $37m to seize more than 70 occupied West Bank sites
english: The Israeli government has allocated $37 million to gain control over more than 70 historical and archaeological sites within the occupied West Bank. Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich frames this move as a way to preserve Jewish heritage, though these locations are located on Palestinian land. These actions are part of a broader, ongoing expansion of settlements that remain illegal under international law.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ የሚገኙ ከ70 በላይ ታሪካዊ እና አርኪኦሎጂያዊ ቦታዎችን ለመቆጣጠር 37 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በጀት መድቧል። የገንዘብ ሚኒስትሩ በዛሌል ስሞትሪች ይህ እርምጃ የአይሁድ ቅርሶችን ለመጠበቅ ያለመ መሆኑን ቢገልጹም፣ ቦታዎቹ ግን በፓለስቲናውያን መሬት ላይ የሚገኙ ናቸው። ይህ ተግባር በዓለም አቀፍ ህግ ህገ-ወጥ ተደርገው በሚቆጠሩት ሰፈራዎች ማስፋፊያ ስራ አካል ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa-gama (West Bank) keessatti bakkeewwan seena-qabeessaafi arki'ooloojii 70 ol ta'an to'achuuf qarshii miiliyoona 37 ramadeera. Ministirri Maallaqaa Bezalel Smotrich tarkaanfiin kun dhaala warra Yihuudii eeguuf kan yaadame ta'uu ibsanus, bakkeewwan kun biyya Palastiinii keessatti kan argamanidha. Gochi kun babal'ina buufataalee seeraan alaa ta'anii kanneen seera idil-addunyaatiin hin beekamne keessatti kan galuudha.

title: US stock market hits record high amid hopes for Strait of Hormuz reopening
english: The US stock market reached unprecedented record highs driven by strong corporate earnings and positive expectations regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. As negotiations led by Iran and Oman progress, international oil prices have declined due to the anticipated restoration of this vital shipping route. This market optimism has also triggered significant growth in key Asian stock exchanges.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የአክሲዮን ገበያ በኩባንያዎች ጠንካራ የገቢ አፈጻጸም እና የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ዳግም ይከፈታል በሚል ተስፋ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ደረጃ አዲስ ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግቧል። ኢራን እና ኦማን በባህረ ሰላጤው የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ ላይ እያደረጉት ያለው ድርድር ውጤታማ ይሆናል በሚል እምነት የነዳጅ ዋጋ ቀንሷል። ይህ የተስፋ መንፈስ በእስያ ዋና ዋና የአክሲዮን ገበያዎች ላይም አዎንታዊ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gabaan aksiyoonii US bu'aa qabeessa ta'uu dhaabbilee fi abdii daandii galaana Hormuz deebi'ee banamuu irratti hundaa'uun hanga kanaan dura hin mul'anneen guddina galmeesseera. Hariiroon biyyoota Iraan fi Omaan gidduutti taasifamaa jiru bu'aa qabaata jedhamee waan amanameef, gatiin boba'aa addunyaa gadi bu'eera. Abdii gabaa kanaanis gabaawwan aksiyoonii gurguddoon biyyoota Eeshiyaa guddina olaanaa agarsiisaniiru.

title: US depleted 'virtually all' long-range precision missiles during Iran war: Report
english: A recent report indicates that the United States has nearly exhausted its supply of advanced long-range precision missiles following its military engagement with Iran. These weapons are vital for targeting enemies from a distance, and their depletion has forced the military to relocate remaining stocks from other global regions. This shortage raises concerns regarding the US military's capacity to sustain high-level strikes without these key precision capabilities.
amharic: አንድ አዲስ ዘገባ እንደሚያሳየው አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር ባደረገችው ጦርነት ምክንያት እጅግ ዘመናዊ የሆኑ የረጅም ርቀት ሚሳኤሎች ክምችቷ ሊያልቅ መድረሱን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ መሳሪያዎች ጠላትን ከራቅ ቦታ በትክክል ለመምታት ወሳኝ በመሆናቸው፣ አሜሪካ የቀሩትን መሳሪያዎች ከሌሎች የአለም ክፍሎች ለማዘዋወር ተገዳለች። ይህ የጦር መሳሪያ እጥረት ሀገሪቱ በወታደራዊ ግጭቶች ላይ ያላትን የመከላከልና የማጥቃት አቅም ላይ ጥያቄን እየፈጠረ ነው።
oromo: gabaasi tokko akka agarsiisutti, Amerikaan waraana Iiraan waliin gooteen booda meeshaalee waraanaa fageenya dheeraa rukutan kan guboo (missiles) hamma baayyee fixattee jirti. Meeshaaleen kunneen diina fageenya irraa rukutuuf baayyee barbaachisoo waan ta'aniif, waraanni Amerikaa amansiisaa ta'e tokko argachuuf meeshaalee isaa bakka biraa irraa guuruuf dirqamee jira. Hanqinni kun ammoo Amerikaan gara fuulduraatti waraana irratti hirmaachuu irratti rakkoo guddaa akka qabaattu shakkisiisaa jira.

title: Trump says talks with Tehran 'very good', threatens to strike if Hormuz Strait remains closed
english: President Trump recently revealed that the United States is engaged in positive negotiations with Iran regarding a potential agreement. However, he also issued a stern warning that Iran must reopen the Strait of Hormuz quickly. If the area remains blocked, the president stated that the U.S. will respond with significant military force.

Ta'us, Iran daandii galaana Hormuz ariitiin banuu qabdi jechuun akeekkachiisaniiru. Daandichi yoo banamuu baate, Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa cimaa fudhachuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru.

title: Explosions reportedly heard in Yemeni capital of Sanaa
english: There have been reports of explosions occurring in Sanaa, the capital city of Yemen. At this time, officials have not confirmed the details of the event. Furthermore, video evidence circulating regarding the incident is currently unverified.
amharic: በየመን ዋና ከተማ በሆነችው ሰንዓ ፍንዳታዎች እንደተሰሙ ሪፖርቶች እየወጡ ነው። እስካሁን ድረስ የዚህ ክስተት ዝርዝር መረጃ በአለማቀፍ አካላት አልተረጋገጠም። እንዲሁም ስለ ጉዳዩ እየተሰራጩ የሚገኙ የምስል ማስረጃዎች ትክክለኛነት እስካሁን አልተረጋገጠም።
oromo: Magaalaa guddoo Yemen, Sanaa keessatti dhoohaan dhaga’amuu isaa gabaasni ni mul’isu. Haa ta’u malee, hanga ammaatti odeeffannoon kun qaama aangoo qabuun kan mirkanaa’e miti. Akkasumas, viidiyoon haala kanaan walqabatee gadi dhiifame dhugummaan isaa hin mirkanaa’e.

title: Reports of blasts in Dubai
english: Several explosions recently occurred within the Jebel Ali industrial zone located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Videos circulating on social media platforms display significant clouds of smoke billowing from the site. Authorities have not yet provided specific details regarding the cause or any potential casualties.

oromo: Emirates Gamtootaa Arabaa, magaalaa Dubaayitti, naannoo warshaa Jebel Alitti osoon gurguddoon dhukaanii akka uumame gabaafame. Viidiyoowwan miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti qoodaman irraa akka hubatamutti, aaraan guddaan bakka sana irraa ol bahaa jira. Abbootiin taayitaa hanga ammaa sababa dhukichaafi miidhaa ga'e irratti ibsa gahaa hin kennine.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's struggle with democracy is rooted in a cultural tendency to favor strict hierarchy and unquestioning obedience over open dialogue. This pattern begins in households and schools, where children learn that challenging authority is often discouraged or penalized. These ingrained habits carry over into workplaces and government institutions, where fear of retaliation suppresses dissent and prevents necessary systemic change.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የዲሞክራሲ ሂደት ተግዳሮት በዋናነት የተመሠረተው ሥልጣንን ያለ ጥያቄ የመቀበልና የባህላዊ አስተዳደር ሥርዓትን የመከተል ዝንባሌ ላይ ነው። ይህ አሠራር ከቤተሰብና ከትምህርት ቤት የሚጀምር ሲሆን፣ ልጆች ሥልጣንን መቃወም እንደ ጥፋት እንዲቆጥሩ ይገደዳሉ። እነዚህ ሥር የሰደዱ ልማዶች ወደ ቢሮዎችና የመንግሥት ተቋማት በመሸጋገር፣ ሰዎች ለሥራቸው ደኅንነት ሲሉ ሃሳባቸውን እንዳይገልጹ በማድረግ ለውጥን ያደናቅፋሉ።
oromo: Rakkoon demokrasii Itoophiyaa keessatti mul'atu aadaa aangoo of harkaa qabuuf ajajamuufi wal-qixxummaa irratti hundaa'e osoo hin taane, caaseffama ol-aantummaa qabu irratti kan hundaa'eedha. Amalli kun maatii fi mana barnootaa irraa kan jalqabu yoo ta'u, ijoolleen aangoo gaafachuu akka hammeenyaatti akka ilaalan barsiifamu. Barumsiifi aadaan kun gara bakka hojii fi dhaabbata mootummaatti kan ce'uufi, namoonni waa'ee haqaas ta'e dogoggoraa dubbachuu sodaatanii akka callisan taasisuun jijjiirama dhugaa ni gufachiisa.

title: Iran war live: Tehran-Oman talks on Hormuz ‘positive’; ship hit in Red Sea
english: Diplomatic discussions between Iran and Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz are reportedly showing positive progress. Both Iranian officials and US government representatives have signaled that an agreement to resolve the ongoing crisis could be finalized in the coming days. Meanwhile, reports indicate that a ship has been struck in the Red Sea as regional tensions persist.
amharic: በኢራን እና በኦማን መካከል ስለ ሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ እየተደረጉ ያሉ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይቶች አዎንታዊ ውጤት እያሳዩ መሆኑ ተገልጿል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት እና የአሜሪካ መንግስት ተወካዮች ችግሩን ለመፍታት የሚያስችል ስምምነት በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ ሊደረስ እንደሚችል አመላክተዋል። በሌላ በኩል የቀይ ባህር ውጥረቶች እንደቀጠሉ ሲሆን አንድ መርከብ ጥቃት እንደደረሰበት ተነግሯል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan diippilomaasii gidduu Iraanii fi Omaan gidduutti, kan dhimma daandii galaana Hormuz irratti xiyyeeffate, bu'aa gaarii argamsiisaa jiraachuun ibsameera. Bakka buutonni Iraanii fi Ameerikaa walii galteen dhimma kana furuuf gargaaru guyyoota dhufan keessatti akka milkaa'u abdataniiru. Gama biraatiin, naannoo Galaana Diimaatti walitti bu'iinsi itti fufuun isaa fi dooniin tokko rukutamuu ishee gabaasni ni mul'isu.

title: US revokes visa of Brazilian ambassador amid deepening diplomatic spat
english: The Trump administration has revoked the visa of Brazil's ambassador to the United States in response to Brazil's delay in approving the American nominee for ambassador to Brasilia. Although the diplomat’s visa is currently cancelled, officials clarified that she is not being expelled from the country. The U.S. stated that her travel documents will be reinstated as soon as Brazil agrees to accept the American candidate, Danny Perez.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር በብራዚል በኩል የአሜሪካውን አምባሳደር የመሾም ሂደት በመዘግየቱ ምክንያት የብራዚሏን አምባሳደር ቪዛ ሰርዘዋል። የቪዛው መሰረዝ አምባሳደሯ ከአሜሪካ እንዲባረሩ አያደርግም ሲሉ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል። ብራዚል የአሜሪካውን እጩ ዳኒ ፔሬዝን እንደተቀበለች የቪዛ እገዳው እንደሚነሳም ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Mootummaan Prezidaant Doonaald Traamp, Braaziliin bakka buutuu ambaasaaddara Ameerikaa gara biyya ishee ergamuudhaaf jiru mirkaneessuu waan turteef, ambaasaaddara Braazil kan Ameerikaa jiran irratti tarkaanfii viizaa fudhateera. Ta'us, kun ambaasaaddarittiin biyyattiirraa akka ari'aman kan godhu miti jedhameera. Ameerikaan, Braazil naggaddee ambaasaaddara Ameerikaa kan ta'an Daanii Pereez fudhachuu yoo mirkaneessite, viizaan ambaasaaddarittii akka deebi'uuf ibsiteetti.

title: Sri Lanka shuts schools as floods and mudslides kill 7
english: Heavy rainfall in Sri Lanka's central highlands has triggered deadly mudslides and floods, resulting in seven fatalities and significant infrastructure damage. Authorities have closed schools in the affected districts and deployed military personnel to evacuate thousands of residents trapped by the rising waters. This disaster comes as the region continues to struggle with the aftermath of previous severe weather events.
amharic: በስሪላንካ መካከለኛ ተራራማ አካባቢዎች በጣለ ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት በተከሰተ ጎርፍ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት ሰባት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። መንግስት በተጎዱ አካባቢዎች ትምህርት ቤቶችን የዘጋ ሲሆን፣ በጎርፍ የተጠመዱ ሺዎችን ለመታደግ የፀጥታ ኃይሎችን አሰማርቷል። ይህ አደጋ ክልሉ ካለፉት የተፈጥሮ አደጋዎች ለማገገም እየጣረ ባለበት ወቅት የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Sri Lankaatti rooba cimaan roobeen hordofee lolaa fi lafti siggiguun lubbuun namoota torbaa darbeera. Bulchiinsi biyyattii manneen barnootaa bakka balaan gahetti akka cufaman taasiseera; akkasumas namoota lolaan qabaman gargaaruuf loltoota bobbaaseera. Balaan kun kan mudate, naannichi balaa rooba kanaan duraatiin miidhamee deebi'ee of ijaaruuf carraaqqii gochaa jirutti.

title: One killed, five injured in Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv
english: A Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv has resulted in one death and five injuries, while causing significant property damage and fires in the capital. Local officials report that air defense systems were deployed to counter the assault, but several buildings were still struck. President Zelenskyy highlighted this tragedy as further evidence of the urgent need for more international support to strengthen Ukraine's missile defense capabilities.
amharic: ሩሲያ በኪዬቭ ላይ በፈጸመችው የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ሲሞት አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ጥቃቱ በከተማዋ የንግድ መጋዘኖች ላይ እሳት ከመቀስቀሱም በላይ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን አውድሟል። የዩክሬን ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ፣ ይህ ጥቃት ሀገራቸው የአየር መከላከያ መሳሪያዎች እንደሚያስፈልጋት የሚያሳይ መሆኑን ገልጸው ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግላቸው ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Raashiyaan magaalaa Kiyiv irratti xiyyaara kombii (ballistic missile) fayyadamtee haleellaa geessisteen lubbuun nama tokkoo darbee namoonni shan ammoo miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun gamoo fi manneen jireenyaa irratti miidhaa geessisuun cinatti, magaalaattis ibidda kaaseera. Preezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenski haleellaan kun Yukreen of ittisuuf meeshaalee waraanaa ammayyaa fi deeggarsa idil-addunyaa akka barbaaddu kan mirkaneessu ta’uu dubbataniiru.

title: Hezbollah chief criticises Lebanon's direct talks with Israel
english: Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem has publicly condemned Lebanese President Joseph Aoun for engaging in direct peace negotiations with Israel. Qassem accused the president of acting in a biased and divisive manner regarding these talks. Meanwhile, the Hezbollah chief stated he is open to holding public discussions with the Syrian government.
